name: Super Group Limited
summary: Super Group Limited engages in the supply chain management, dealership, and fleet management activities in South Africa, Africa, Europe, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates through Supply Chain, Fleet Africa, SG Fleet, Dealerships SA, Dealerships UK, and Services segments. The company provides supply chain services comprising transportation, warehousing and distribution, courier services, vehicle rental and passenger transport, cross-border transport, supply chain technologies and equipment, and other services. It also offers driver, fuel and tyre management; accident and insurance administration, fleet optimization and route planning; vehicle tracking and recovery; 24/7/365…
